findings.title: Committed evidence exceeds required aggregate storage limit
findings.description: At the exact reviewed revision, the 634 changed own evidence/review regular Git blobs total 18,099,028 bytes versus the unchanged 16,777,216-byte inclusive cap, an overage of 1,321,812 bytes before new V2 review notes. Required checks and protocol behavior have supporting exact-SHA evidence, but the required storage admission remains unsatisfied. BLOCKED/UNMERGED in the result is truthful and does not waive this correction.
findings.required_correction: Resolve lossless capture/storage through separate reviewed prospective governance; supply a compliant exact-revision storage audit and fresh SHA-bound reviews. Preserve execution/failure history and unchanged PASS/frozen meanings.
